verdict.rationale: Dialpad's own llms.txt lists an overview of its Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for connecting Dialpad with AI tools and agents, a first-party signal that an official MCP integration exists. The evidence is a single index-line mention with no detail, so it is unclear whether this is a hosted or installable MCP server and what it actually exposes. Missing for 10: confirmation that it is an official MCP server (endpoint or install method), the list of exposed tools and resources, auth and setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
